text:
A checkpoint is not a traffic stop, and the rules are not the same.

Local news carried 137 checkpoint announcements in the past week.

You were not pulled over for anything. Knowing what that changes — and what it does not — is the whole difference.

You can refuse a search — “I don't consent to any searches, officer.” Refusing is not evidence against you, and by itself it does not give an officer a reason to search.

Amparo has a free drill for exactly this moment — the Checkpoint drill. Three minutes, no account, English or Spanish.

Practice it, then build your free glovebox pack: https://www.amparohq.com/arena/?sit=ck&utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=checkpoint_en
